name: vid2context
description: Turn any video into context for AI agents: transcripts, metadata, chapters and cited research briefs. Free-first, works with local or hosted AI, ships as a CLI, MCP server, HTTP API and web app.

scripts.test:live: npm run gen && LIVE=1 vitest run
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.test:site: npm --prefix site test && npm --prefix site run test:e2e
scripts.dev:worker: npm run gen && npm run build:site && npm run build:assets && wrangler dev --local
scripts.deploy: npm run gen && npm run build:site && npm run build:assets && wrangler deploy
scripts.build:npm: npm run gen && tsx packages/discovery/src/cli.ts build
scripts.build:vercel: npm run gen && npm run build:site && node deploy/serverless/vercel/build.mjs
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run gen && npm run build:site && node deploy/serverless/github-pages/publish.mjs
